rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 quintet voice (Boris-direct + Godin peer-warmth) holds throughout; 'theatre' metaphor (line 34) checked curriculum-wide, consistent negative valence everywhere else it appears (skills-from-the-frontier.md, trainer-modules.md, earn-the-trust.md) — no collision.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise file, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named practitioner technique paraphrased in body without credit. Creator-name ban, author-we ban both hold: no 'Antti'/'the creator'/'the author' or organisational 'we' in body (line 30's quoted '"we don't mock the database"' is quoted student-team voice, an explicit carve-out).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No maintainer-only term-of-art (substrate, self-compound, three-pattern, grill-me) appears unearned in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 59 'Personal stays a fine final home' reads as a genuine option statement (followed by a concrete test), not reassurance defending a lesser choice.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a reference artefact capturing a user-supplied verbal frame.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named practitioner attribution in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Punchy lines ('Authoring without invocation is theatre', 'Agents don't unilaterally change shared team infrastructure. You do.') read as general truths for this exercise, not overreaching claims needing a boundary paragraph.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No flag phrases ('not an aspirational X', 'not a vendor Y', 'grounded in actual', etc.) and no use of 'vendor' in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bare M4/M6 fine at M3 per the abbreviation rule. 'Same-window self-charity' (line 45) is defined in the same sentence it's used, not planted cold.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Section closers checked cold (Phase 1, Phase 2, Sharpen, Phase 3, graduation section) — every pronoun/demonstrative resolves to a concrete single referent; no vague spatial/temporal metaphor standing in for an action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Past tense for exercise recap sections — heading and body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: '**What happened:**' (line 61, canonical heading) narrates in past tense ('Shipped.'); 'living in your personal skills folder' is the still-true-artifact exception.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No spatial/structural metaphor headers, no unanchored 'other X'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No corrective-gap framing, no ability-tier pegging, no pre-flight gates present to check for plausible-failability.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'worktree' and 'CLAUDE.local.md' (Note, line 69) are established AE101 conventions by M3; bare M4/M6 fine at this arc position per the M2+ carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule is scoped 'Agents 101 default'; this is an AE101 file for software engineers, not the SVP-marketing-test audience.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No blurred memory/context usage in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The Note on worktree leftovers is post-exercise housekeeping guidance, not a failure-recovery/troubleshooting branch.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body doesn't over-specify SKILL.md's shape; the 'don't over-specify' note lives correctly below the maintainer cut (Watch-fors).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module — never repeat same Debrief.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No retro-interview structure in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'ask Claude if the test strategy is any good' and 'ask the skill itself to name its own weakest part' both route error-catching through Claude, not manual diffing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a self-study simulation file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All authoring/invocation/sharpening moves stay in chat via prompts; the editor-hand-crafting warning correctly lives below the maintainer cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body doesn't reference bare CLAUDE.md; the one CLAUDE.local.md mention (line 69) is already layer-specific and sits in the maintainer-adjacent Note.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep-confirmed: all em-dash hits in the file are at line ≥75, below the line-71 maintainer cut. Body region (lines 1–70) has none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phase headers lead with verbs (Author, Answer, Invoke, Sharpen, Ship, Decide); 'What this sets up' is a declarative forward-look section (understanding, not doing), which the rule exempts.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No markdown links in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Team-shaped by nature, but it ships personal first' (line 21) and the personal-vs-team-PR framing already separate the personal skill this exercise authors from a team-kit skill; no unresolved collision.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 45: 'Claude invoked the skill it just helped author, then graded the result in the same context window' — invoking and grading are autonomous actions, which the rule defaults to 'the agent', not 'Claude'.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Consider 'the agent invoked the skill it just helped author, then graded the result' unless the point is specifically identity-continuity (same Claude instance), in which case name that explicitly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No contemplative-pause prefixes or self-aware pedagogy headers in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
`.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The one artifact saved (SKILL.md) is already .md.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No implementation detail, admin aside, or maintainer-reasoning leak spotted in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'read it'/'look at it' narration after a described chat-print moment.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'What this sets up' section: 'Module 4 reads this skill as part of the system you have. M4 ... consumes the test-strategy skill as a quality-criterion anchor.' and 'M6 authors a verifier skill the same way you authored this one. The move repeats and gets faster.' — closing sentences have the module/the move as grammatical subject, not the student.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Recast from the student's arc, e.g. 'You'll hand this skill to M4's memory work' / 'You'll author the next one faster at M6.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No per-module operational setting (thinking-effort, model choice, mode tag) referenced in this file.
